gates.reason: No code was released and the paper leaves behavior-changing details unstated or contradictory: heatmap projection and width, the content of the 7 channels per joint, keyframe clustering, the meaning of FL-4, how hand masks enter the feature, hand-segmentation training (including left/right labels for HGR, whose masks are unlabelled skin masks), CNN depth and dropout, learning rate, epochs, checkpoint choice and seed.
evidence: Sec. 3.4 text: '6 convolutional layers' and dropout 0.5; same section: '2 blocks of layers, each with 2 convolutional layers'; Table 3 row '0.25 2 2 128 78.21 96.84' equals Table 4 row 'None 3 78.21 96.84'.
Table 1: 'Hue + KF + Static keyshot: 11 joints, 7 channels, 5K static frames'; '#joints x #channels + #static frames yields the final input dimensionality'.
Sec. 3.3: three classes (left hand, right hand, background), Rendered Handpose Dataset plus HGR, DeepLab v3+, 1% validation; no backbone, input size or schedule.
Sec. 3.2: K + 2 keyframes with the first and last discarded; density clustering [40] with no parameters.
Kinect files in the dataset hold, per joint and frame: camera-space x, y, z (m), an orientation quaternion, color-image pixel x, y (1920x1080) and depth-image pixel x, y (512x424).
gates.required_action: Decide the unstated details before any training run, and whether values obtained under them count as produced targets or as conditional evidence.
gates.resolution: Decided by a study team member before any training run. CNN: 2 blocks of 2 convolutional layers, 128 initial filters, dropout 0.25 (the Table 3 row that Table 4 reuses). Joint positions: the Kinect files' color-image pixel coordinates scaled from 1920x1080 to 116x64; Gaussian standard deviation 2 pixels; 'upper arms' are the shoulder joints. Seven channels per joint: hue-colored image (3), intensity (1), normalized image (3). Keyframes: density-peaks clustering on (frame, speed) points of the dominant hand's speed minima, the 6 strongest peaks, first and last dropped; FL-4 means 4 keyframes kept, giving 20 mask channels and 97 input channels. Hand masks: whole-frame mask of both hands resized to 116x64, one channel per frame. Segmentation: DeepLab v3+ with an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 backbone in PyTorch, on the Rendered Handpose Dataset plus HGR1, HGR2A and HGR2B; HGR images are trained as hand versus background only, so no left/right label is invented. Classifier training: Adam, learning rate 0.001, batch 32, 100 epochs, weights after the last epoch, no selection on the test set; seed 0 is the reported value and seeds 1 and 2 are supplementary. Framework: PyTorch on the study base image. Values obtained under these choices are conditional evidence and do not count as produced targets.

guesses_and_deviations.used: The Kinect files' color-image pixel coordinates scaled from 1920x1080 to 116x64; Gaussian standard deviation 2 pixels; 'upper arms' are the shoulder joints; the background map is the maximum over all 25 joints.

guesses_and_deviations.description: The content of the '7 channels' per joint and the hue coloring.
guesses_and_deviations.paper_says: Table 1: 'Hue: 11 joints, 7 channels'. Sec. 3.1.2: hue = subunit, saturation = time within the unit, value = heatmap strength. Sec. 3.2: hue n x 180 / (K + 1).
guesses_and_deviations.used: Per joint, PoTion's three descriptors on an RGB rendering of the HSV image: colored sum (3), intensity (1), normalized (3). Hue n / (K + 1) of the color circle (OpenCV's 0-180 scale); saturation rises linearly within a segment.
guesses_and_deviations.basis: PoTion's 2c+1 gives 7 for 3 color channels, and Figure 3 shows three rows of which one is 'obtained by normalizing'. Decided at gate taf-unstated-protocol before any training run.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: Unknown; could change both target values.

guesses_and_deviations.description: Keyframe detection (HS+DC) and the meaning of FL-4.
guesses_and_deviations.paper_says: Sec. 3.2: local minima of the dominant hand's speed, K + 2 keyframes with the first and last discarded, 'density clustering' [40]. Table 5: 'FL-# means # keyframes'.
guesses_and_deviations.used: Hand joint speed in camera coordinates; dominant hand = longer path; density-peaks clustering on normalized (frame, speed) points with a Gaussian kernel at the 2nd-percentile distance; the 6 points with the largest density x distance; first and last dropped; 4 keyframes kept, 5 colored segments. Fewer than 6 minima: evenly spaced frames.
guesses_and_deviations.basis: Decided at gate taf-unstated-protocol before any training run.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: Unknown; could change both target values.

guesses_and_deviations.description: How hand masks enter the feature.

guesses_and_deviations.used: Per keyshot frame one 116x64 channel: the whole-frame mask of both hands, a cell set if any hand pixel falls in it. 20 mask channels, 97 input channels.
guesses_and_deviations.basis: Table 1 counts one channel per static frame. Decided at gate taf-unstated-protocol before any training run.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: At 116x64 a hand covers a few cells, so little hand shape is kept; a hand crop would be a different feature. Unknown; could change both target values.
